title: Orthonormal coordinates adapted to a unit (n+1)-orientation of a plane (parent steps 1–3)
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, P := n + 1 + k, let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace and let ξ ∈ Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P (n+1): continuous linear functionals on (n+1)-covectors) be a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there is an orthonormal family τ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ^P with span(range τ) = Q such that ξ(α) = α(τ) for all α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ) for all α). Then there are linear isometries ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^P such that ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝ^{n+1}, w ∈ ℝ^k; every y ∈ ℝ^P equals ιv + ι'w for some v, w; range ι = Q (as sets); and ξ(α) = α(ιe_0, …, ιe_n) for every (n+1)-covector α, where e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1 is the standard basis of ℝ^{n+1}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + 1 + k))) (ξ : MultiVector (n + 1 + k) (n + 1)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ∃ (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) ∧ (∀ y : Euclid (n + 1 + k), ∃ v w, y = ι v + ι' w) ∧ Set.range ι = (Q : Set (Euclid (n + 1 + k))) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (n + 1), ξ α = α (fun j => ι (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))
